invariants: one canonical source and revision, two distinct view instances
bounds mutate only view; source hash/revision/ACL unchanged
layout is persisted by same Core and restored after new page
notebook export available to same role as baseline; manifest and losses exact
tutor sees only explicitly submitted revision, never private head
new source revision cannot relabel content of historical source
STALE differs from UNAVAILABLE and excludes current recall derivatives

invariants: all four dates visible, edition global capacity10, interests not paid enrollment
original assets preserved, transcription a separate revision
review and diary anchored to exact procedure/source/revision
new attempt and transfer verification distinct from arbitrary correct number

trace_application_feature + trace_javascript_semantics around source/layout or exact revision presenter
reconcile_javascript_runtime with exact shipped asset hashes

aligned before/after comparison on new candidate same origin for view or revision state
auth_policy: QA fixture released; only read-only existing student-01 used in candidate1. No credentials in public JSON, no resets. Final writes must remain coordinated.
exit: Research alone cannot create PASS; root must integrate missing UI controls, run exact-SHA product tests, and write authentic receipt.
